tasks.title: Create Cloudflare R2 Account and Project
tasks.description: Set up Cloudflare R2 account and create project for secure backup storage.
tasks.details: Sign up for Cloudflare R2 service. Create a new R2 project specifically for AFROTC backup storage. Document account credentials and project settings. Verify account has sufficient permissions for bucket creation and management.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify R2 account access and project creation. Test basic API connectivity and permissions.

tasks.title: Configure Private R2 Buckets for Backups
tasks.description: Create and configure private R2 buckets for secure backup storage.
tasks.details: Create private buckets for backups and documents. Configure bucket policies to deny public access. Set up CORS configuration for uploads from your domain. Configure lifecycle rules for automatic cleanup of old backups.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify buckets are private and not publicly accessible. Test CORS configuration and lifecycle rules.

tasks.title: Set Up R2 Custom Domain and WAF Rules
tasks.description: Configure custom domain for R2 access and implement WAF security rules.
tasks.details: Set up custom domain for R2 access (optional but recommended). Configure WAF rules for rate limiting, IP blocking, and geographic restrictions. Add security headers and DDoS protection.
tasks.testStrategy: Test custom domain access and verify WAF rules are working. Confirm security headers are present.

tasks.title: Add Boto3 Dependencies and R2 Client Setup
tasks.description: Add boto3 to requirements and create R2 client configuration.
tasks.details: Add boto3==1.34.0 and botocore==1.34.0 to requirements.txt. Create get_r2_client() function in neon_backup_scheduler.py using boto3 S3 client with R2 endpoint. Configure environment variables for R2 access. Test basic R2 connectivity.
tasks.testStrategy: Test boto3 installation and R2 client connection. Verify environment variables are properly configured.

tasks.title: Implement R2 Operations with Boto3
tasks.description: Create R2 upload, download, and list functions using boto3.
tasks.details: Implement upload_backup_to_r2(), list_backup_files_r2(), and download_backup_file_r2() functions using boto3 S3 client. Use proper error handling with ClientError exceptions. Ensure functions work with existing backup scheduling system.
tasks.testStrategy: Test upload, download, and list operations with various file types and sizes. Verify error handling and retry mechanisms.

tasks.title: Update Backup System to Use R2
tasks.description: Modify existing backup functions to use R2 instead of Vercel Blob.
tasks.details: Update create_backup(), list_backup_files(), and download_backup_file() functions in neon_backup_scheduler.py to use R2 operations instead of Vercel Blob. Maintain backward compatibility during transition. Update backup file naming and metadata.
tasks.testStrategy: Test backup creation and storage in R2. Verify backup integrity and metadata. Ensure existing functionality continues to work.

tasks.title: Update Website Routes for R2 Downloads
tasks.description: Modify website routes to use R2 for backup downloads.
tasks.details: Update backup download routes in app.py to use R2 operations. Implement server-side proxy for downloads (no direct R2 URLs exposed). Add proper error handling and user feedback. Ensure authentication and authorization checks.
tasks.testStrategy: Test backup download functionality through website. Verify proper error handling and user experience.

tasks.title: Create Data Migration Script
tasks.description: Develop comprehensive script to migrate data from Vercel Blob to R2.
tasks.details: Create migration script to download all files from Vercel Blob and upload to R2. Include file integrity verification. Update database URLs to point to R2 locations. Handle large file transfers efficiently.
tasks.testStrategy: Test migration script with sample data. Verify file integrity and database updates.

tasks.title: Execute Data Migration from Vercel Blob to R2
tasks.description: Perform actual data migration from Vercel Blob to Cloudflare R2.
tasks.details: Run migration script to transfer all backup files to R2. Monitor migration progress and handle any errors. Verify all files are successfully transferred. Update database with new R2 URLs.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify all files are present in R2. Confirm database URLs are updated correctly.

tasks.title: Update Admin Interface for R2 Downloads
tasks.description: Modify admin interface to use R2 signed URLs instead of direct blob URLs.
tasks.details: Update admin backup management interface to use R2 download routes. Replace direct blob URL links with secure signed URL generation. Add download progress indicators. Implement proper error handling.
tasks.testStrategy: Test admin interface with R2 downloads. Verify no direct URLs are exposed.

tasks.title: Implement Download Logging and Audit Trail
tasks.description: Add comprehensive logging for all R2 download activities.
tasks.details: Create backup_download_log table for tracking all download attempts. Log user ID, backup ID, timestamp, IP address, and success/failure status. Implement download activity monitoring dashboard.
tasks.testStrategy: Test logging functionality and verify all downloads are tracked. Check audit trail completeness.

tasks.title: Add Rate Limiting and Access Control
tasks.description: Implement rate limiting and granular access control for R2 downloads.
tasks.details: Add rate limiting to R2 download routes (e.g., 100 requests/hour per IP). Implement granular access control for different admin roles. Add IP whitelisting for sensitive operations.
tasks.testStrategy: Test rate limiting and access control. Verify limits are enforced correctly.

tasks.title: Update Document Upload/Download for R2
tasks.description: Modify document upload and download system to use R2 storage.
tasks.details: Update document upload functionality to use R2 instead of Vercel Blob. Modify document download routes to use signed URLs. Update document metadata tracking. Ensure backward compatibility.
tasks.testStrategy: Test document upload and download with R2. Verify all document operations work correctly.

tasks.title: Comprehensive Testing and Validation
tasks.description: Perform thorough testing of all R2 functionality and security measures.
tasks.details: Test all backup and document operations with R2. Verify security measures are working. Test performance and error handling. Conduct security audit to ensure no public access exists.
tasks.testStrategy: Run comprehensive test suite covering all functionality. Verify security requirements are met.

tasks.title: Performance Testing and Optimization
tasks.description: Test R2 performance and optimize for production use.
tasks.details: Test download and upload performance with various file sizes. Optimize signed URL generation and caching. Test concurrent access and load handling. Verify performance meets requirements.
tasks.testStrategy: Run performance tests and compare with previous Vercel Blob performance. Optimize based on results.

tasks.title: Production Deployment and Monitoring
tasks.description: Deploy R2 migration to production and set up monitoring.
tasks.details: Deploy R2 integration to production environment. Set up monitoring for R2 operations and performance. Monitor for any issues or errors. Verify all functionality works in production.
tasks.testStrategy: Monitor production deployment and verify all systems are working correctly.

tasks.title: Remove Vercel Blob Integration
tasks.description: Clean up and remove old Vercel Blob integration after successful R2 migration.
tasks.details: Remove Vercel Blob SDK and related code. Clean up environment variables. Update documentation to reflect R2 usage. Archive old Vercel Blob configuration.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify no Vercel Blob dependencies remain and all functionality uses R2.

tasks.title: Documentation and Training
tasks.description: Update documentation and provide training for new R2-based system.
tasks.details: Update system documentation to reflect R2 usage. Create admin training materials for new backup access system. Document cost savings and security improvements. Provide troubleshooting guides.
tasks.testStrategy: Review documentation completeness and gather admin feedback on new system.

metadata.description: Cloudflare R2 Migration for Secure Backup Storage
